text.en:
24th. JULY, 2000 No. S63

INTERNATIONAL BUSINESS COMPANIES ORDER, 2000 NOTIFICATION UNDER SECTION 1(1) In exercise of the power conferred by section 1 ( 1), the Minister of Finance, with the approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, hereby appoints the 1st. July, 2000 as the day on which the International Business Companies Order, 2000 shall commence. Dated this 26th. day of Rabiulawal, 1421 Hijriah corresponding to the 29th. day of June, 2000.

AWANG HAJI ABDUL HAMID BIN HAJI JANUDIN Acting Permanent Secretary, Ministry of Finance, Brunei Darussalam.
